datasets.title: Gambia - Catchment areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows Gambia catchment areas with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/the-gambia-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters from gridded WorldPop and META datasets, assigning representative points to each settlement cluster, and using Voronoi tessellation or similar spatial algorithms to delineate catchment boundaries. Population data from multiple sources (WorldPop 2020, META 2023) were disaggregated by sex and age groups, and building counts from OpenStreetMap and Google Buildings were integrated to create a comprehensive spatial inventory of settlements and their associated populations and infrastructure.

sources.name: WorldPop
sources.description: Gridded population data for 2020 used to identify population clusters and generate catchment areas for settlements

sources.name: META (Facebook/Meta)
sources.description: High-resolution population estimates disaggregated by sex and age groups (2023) integrated into catchment area analysis

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprint data (2023) contributing to building stock inventory within catchment areas

sources.name: Google Buildings
sources.description: Automated building detection data at multiple confidence thresholds (60%, 70%, 80%) from 2023 satellite imagery

asset_type.description: Total population disaggregated by sex and age groups (children under 5, people 15-24, women 15-49, people 60+) within catchment areas
